sdkReportedCostMeaning: Known SDK-reported lower bound; missing provider usage is not estimated
completeUsageMeaning: Complete only within observed persisted usage; any summarization evidence remains conservatively unknown without an attempt-to-usage mapping. Not provider billing completeness.
previewMilestoneMeaning: Host request-start time for successful Preview launch after the last observed explicit Root edit/write, with successful stop and no failed observed query on that execution. A query need not occur. This is not feature acceptance; shell mutations and semantic validation scope require manual review.
usageCompletenessMeaning: Conservative public accounting: incomplete includes unknown attempt coverage; original derived flag retained under sourceDerivedFields.
clockMeaning: Wall-clock is wrapper invocation to exit; model/tool/lock sums can overlap. Neither Preview milestone is feature acceptance.
toolOutcomeMeaning: transportErrors is the SDK isError flag, not a network-specific error classification. Non-game operation success only means this flag was false.
